synthesis:draft.headline: SA1 had a single five-minute RRP spike of $845.0 at 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST (interval end 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z) but AEMO reserve notices alone are not sufficient evidence to attribute that spike to the flagged reserve shortfalls.
summary: The price extreme: Regional Reference Price $845.0 at interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (2026-07-29 17:25 ACST) [price evidence ev0445].
There were 26 five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of $300.0 in the window (intervals_at_or_above_threshold evidence ev0884; analysis_threshold evidence ev0886).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND (five-minute) at the price interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z was 1964.83 MW (ev0446); net interchange then was -162.76 MW (net flow into SA1/import) (ev0447).

Operational demand (half-hour average) for the half-hour ending 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z is 1872.0 MW (ev0912); the window maximum operational demand reported is 2144.0 MW (interval ending 2026-07-29T09:30:00Z) (ev0915).

A public forecast run in the snapshot showed POE50 2042.0 MW for the half-hour ending 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z (ev1000); the measured half-hour operational demand for that half-hour was 1872.0 MW (ev0912).

The PDPASA Forecast LOR1 notice (AEMO market notice 144652) gives 2026-07-29 06:30 ACST (2026-07-28T21:00:00Z), before the first five-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The STPASA Forecast LOR2 notice (AEMO market notice 144627) gives 2026-07-29 15:30 ACST (2026-07-29T06:00:00Z), before the first five-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

Other reserve notices and cancellations for 29/07/2026 were published in the retrieved set (see published_findings); their published times (local and UTC) are before the price extreme as shown in the notice timings returned to the controller.

possible_explanations.statement: Market participants responding to AEMO reserve notices such as the PDPASA LOR1 notice [c5] or the STPASA LOR2 notice [c2] might have changed offers or rebids in the morning before the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z, contributing to a high-priced dispatch outcome.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain participant offer/rebid logs and pre-dispatch/offer stacks covering 2026-07-29T07:50:00Z and 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z and check for high-priced offers or capacity withdrawals immediately before the price interval.

possible_explanations.statement: A transient local supply reduction (for example a unit trip or temporary reduction in available low-cost generation) might have reduced supply into the dispatch interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z and coincided with higher-priced offers, producing the single-interval spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect unit availability/outage reports, SCADA unit traces and constraint/dispatch advisories for the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z and the immediately preceding intervals (e.g. interval ending 2026-07-29T07:50:00Z) for evidence of a plant trip or rapid ramp.

possible_explanations.statement: A binding constraint or interconnector limit interacting with local offers could have produced a local price separation at the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z while the region was importing (net interchange -162.76 MW) [ev0447].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve constraint binding logs and interconnector scheduling/limit changes for the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z and adjacent intervals to see if a constraint bound or interconnector limit changed at that time.
